def VTask.map {α β} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) : Matroid β :=
  let E' := f '' M.E
  let indep' (s : Set β) := s ⊆ E' ∧ M.Indep (f ⁻¹' s)

  { E := E'
    indep := indep'
    indep_empty := by
      constructor
      · simp [E', image_subset]
      · simp [preimage_empty, M.indep_empty]
    indep_subset := by
      intro s t hst hti
      constructor
      · apply subset.trans hst; exact hti.1
      · apply M.indep_subset (preimage_mono hst)
        exact hti.2
    indep_exchange := by
      intro s t hEs hEt hsi hti hcard
      let S := f ⁻¹' s
      let T := f ⁻¹' t
      have hS := hsi.2
      have hT := hti.2
      have hcardST := by
        rw [← card_image_of_inj_on hf S (subset.image_subset _ hEs)]
        rw [← card_image_of_inj_on hf T (subset.image_subset _ hEt)]
        exact hcard
      obtain ⟨x, hxT, hxS, hSx⟩ := M.indep_exchange hS hT hcardST
      use [f x]
      constructor
      · apply subset.trans (subset_union_left _ _)
        · simp [hEs, hEt, hf.InjectiveOn, S, T]
        · exact subset.trans (subset_union_right _ _) hEt
      · constructor
        · simp [E', hEs, hEt, hf.InjectiveOn]
        · apply M.Indep.union_singleton hSx
  }
